implementation_notes.dynamic_id_replacement: The script uses placeholder IDs like <TECHCORP_ACCOUNT_ID>, <JOHN_SMITH_CONTACT_ID>, etc. The implementation must:
steps: 1. Create the account first (TechCorp) and capture its GUID
2. Create the contact and link it to the account using the captured GUID
3. Create the opportunity and link it to the contact
4. Create all tasks and link them to the opportunity
5. Replace placeholder GUIDs in the response message with actual created GUIDs
6. Replace {dynamics_url} and {app_id} placeholders with actual Dynamics 365 URL and Sales App ID

clickable_links.description: Each created record includes a clickable link that opens directly in Dynamics 365

parameters.app_id: The Sales Hub app ID (typically 'd365default' or your custom sales app ID)
parameters.entity_type: The logical name of the entity (contact, opportunity, task, etc.)
parameters.record_guid: The GUID of the specific record to open

environment_variables.DYNAMICS_365_RESOURCE: Base URL of your Dynamics 365 organization
environment_variables.DYNAMICS_365_SALES_APP_ID: Optional - Sales Hub App ID (defaults to 'd365default')

implementation_notes.error_handling: If any CRM operation fails, the agent should:
error_steps: 2. Attempt to continue with remaining operations
3. Include error information in the response

opportunity_fields.name: Opportunity name
opportunity_fields.estimatedvalue: Estimated deal value in base currency

task_fields.subject: Task subject/title
task_fields.regardingobjectid: Link to related record (opportunity, contact, etc.)

notes: This demo script is designed to showcase the Speech to CRM Agent's capabilities by ACTUALLY creating records in Dynamics 365. The automation will send each user message in sequence and execute the specified agent calls to create real CRM data. Each step includes the exact Dynamics365CRUD agent calls with proper data payloads. The implementation should handle GUID tracking and replacement throughout the flow.
